periods.summary: Lambert Rabe appears at Edelberg as Red Scorpio, a USSS captain who once met Ascaride while guarding an American meeting. He intervenes when Gale harasses Stella and recognizes both Stella and the Black Knight. He and Kiba are veterans of the Baltic crisis and have been preparing for ten days to challenge Edelweiss at peak condition. Before they can ascend, Xiaoli appears; after Kiba is defeated, Rabe uses flash tactics and his poison Device Death Stinger, but Xiaoli reads his intent, counters with poison via copied or internalized ability, and leaves him paralyzed but alive.

key_events.summary: Intervenes against Gale and introduces himself as Red Scorpio.
Loses to Xiaoli after his poison ambush fails.
